provenance.reported_origin: User-shared version 10 names assigned to GC 3.0a5.2 Windows addresses; origin not independently verified.

status: Unverified name candidates; not consumed by the build or objdiff address resolver.
limitations: An address inside executable memory is not proof of a function boundary or source-file ownership.
Version 10 names may differ from GC3 or the supplied Mac symbols. Preserve conflicting names until native semantics corroborate them.
Saved Ghidra entries are independent boundary leads, not proof of a symbol identity or complete membership.
Data names do not prove allocation extents, types, or TU ownership.
Import ordinals and other out-of-image addresses are excluded; autogenerated address placeholders are excluded.
